newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends softer in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends softer in range-bound trade.

text.p: The Philippine peso ended a tad weaker at 26.280 to the dollar from 26.276 as the Central Bank dictated the tempo throughout Wednesday's session, traders said.
The Central Bank initially bought dollars at 26.268 to keep the peso from rising further, but reversed its strategy when the rate fell to its selling band of 26.28.
It bought approximately $11 million to keep the peso from rising, and then sold $25 million to stem the depreciation.
